phase: Phase S2: Build Initial Accessory Library
summary: Seventeen static accessory templates were registered across head, hand, body, back, and waist identities; geometry, material, port, and required-feature contracts were validated. The S2 checkpoint recorded 195 passing tests, 93.79% statements / 83.26% branches coverage, ESLint and dependency-cruiser clean, and the owner manual verification was approved on 2026-07-19 with 'Great work. Let's continue on.'.
nonblocking_findings: Sub-task bullet markers inside completed tasks use `- [x]` rather than the canonical task-level `[x]` marker, which is tolerated when the task itself carries its commit SHA evidence.
